verified_facts: EA publishes a DTM1m WCS service link
WCS clients discover an input coverage after entering the service URL
coverage metadata is supplied by the service rather than by a parcel record
the DTM1m metadata page also exposes coverage metadata services
a WCS endpoint alone does not establish a candidate-specific coverage identifier
axis labels and grid envelope must come from actual service metadata
candidate sampling must remain blocked when usable coverage metadata has not been read
quality_effect: Keeps CoverageId, axes and grid envelope unknown until actual WCS metadata is successfully read.
